requirement_text: A patient shall pay an outstanding consultation payment through the payment gateway.
A doctor shall view the medical record for an authorized patient.
The system shall notify a customer when an order is shipped.
A customer shall submit a review for a delivered product.
A bank officer shall review a suspicious transaction alert.
A bank customer shall create a new beneficiary for fund transfers.
A member shall pay an overdue fine.
A librarian shall review overdue loans.
The system shall notify a student when assignment feedback is published.
A student shall download course learning materials.
The system shall notify a candidate when an interview is scheduled.
An employee shall submit an expense claim with supporting receipts.
The system shall notify a traveler when a flight schedule changes.
A traveler shall download a booking confirmation.
A driver shall upload proof of delivery after completing a shipment.
A dispatcher shall review failed delivery attempts.
